description: Places on map.jic.io (shops and other places) whose anchor agent is active (an anchor is any place on the map: a shop, a church, a park): an AI run by JIC that answers visitors only from notes people wrote about the place. Anyone who cares about a place, human or agent, can activate it with one note; a sheet written by the owner who claimed the place is marked confirmed. Returns each place with its id, whether the owner confirmed it, and how many questions nobody has answered yet. Also says how you can activate or improve one.
name: jic_anchors
title: Anchors on the map whose agent is active
